questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education (Amendment) Act, 2019:
I. It mandates a regular examination in the fifth class and in the eighth class at the end of every academic year.
II. If a child fails the examination, they must be immediately expelled from the school.
III. The appropriate Government may allow schools to hold back a child in the fifth class or in the eighth class if they fail the re- examination. Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Statements I and III are correct; Statement II is false. The 2019 amendment provides for regular examinations in Classes 5 and 8. A child who fails must receive additional instruction and an opportunity for re-examination. Where the appropriate Government has made the relevant provision, a child may be held back only after failing the re-examination. The Act does not permit immediate expulsion; the child’s right to continue elementary education remains protected.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर I और III है। 2019 के संशोधन के अनुसार कक्षा 5 और 8 में नियमित परीक्षा की व्यवस्था है। यदि बच्चा असफल होता है, तो विद्यालय को अतिरिक्त शिक्षण देना और निर्धारित अवधि के भीतर पुनःपरीक्षा का अवसर देना होता है। राज्य सरकार की संबंधित नीति के अधीन, पुनःपरीक्षा में असफल होने पर बच्चे को उसी कक्षा में रोका जा सकता है, लेकिन उसे विद्यालय से निष्कासित नहीं किया जा सकता।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) I and III

Statements I and III are correct; Statement II is false. The 2019 amendment provides for regular examinations in Classes 5 and 8. A child who fails must receive additional instruction and an opportunity for re-examination. Where the appropriate Government has made the relevant provision, a child may be held back only after failing the re-examination. The Act does not permit immediate expulsion; the child’s right to continue elementary education remains protected.

Consider the following procedures concerning holding back a child under amended Section 16 of the RTE Act:
I. Additional instruction must be provided to a child who fails the regular examination.
II. A re-examination must be held within two months.
III. The State Government may allow a school to hold back a child who fails the re-examination.
IV. The child may be expelled from school if the re-examination is failed. Which statements reflect the amended Act?
questions.explanation_english: The amended detention mechanism requires conducting regular examinations, providing remedial instruction upon failure, holding re- examinations within two months, and allowing state governments discretion to permit holding back failing students. However, expelling any child from school remains strictly prohibited under all circumstances throughout the elementary stage, preserving fundamental rights to educational completion.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर I, II और III है। संशोधित धारा 16 में असफल बच्चे को अतिरिक्त शिक्षण और पुनःपरीक्षा का अवसर देना आवश्यक है; पुनःपरीक्षा सामान्यतः परिणाम घोषित होने के दो महीने के भीतर होती है। राज्य सरकार की नीति अनुमति देती हो तो पुनःपरीक्षा में असफल होने पर कक्षा 5 या 8 में बच्चे को रोका जा सकता है। यह संशोधन बच्चे को विद्यालय से निष्कासित करने की अनुमति नहीं देता, इसलिए कथन IV गलत है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I, II and III

The amended detention mechanism requires conducting regular examinations, providing remedial instruction upon failure, holding re- examinations within two months, and allowing state governments discretion to permit holding back failing students. However, expelling any child from school remains strictly prohibited under all circumstances throughout the elementary stage, preserving fundamental rights to educational completion.

I. मान्यता की शर्तों का उल्लंघन होने पर मान्यता वापस ली जा सकती है।
II. मान्यता वापस लेने से पहले विद्यालय को सुनवाई का अवसर देना आवश्यक है।
III. मान्यता वापस होने पर विद्यार्थियों को किसी अन्य मान्यता-प्राप्त विद्यालय में स्थानांतरित किया जाना चाहिए।
IV. मान्यता वापस होने के बाद विद्यालय एक शैक्षणिक वर्ष तक काम जारी रख सकता है।
कौन-से कथन सही हैं?

questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding the withdrawal of recognition under Section 18:
I. Recognition can be withdrawn if a school contravenes the conditions of recognition.
II. Before withdrawal, an opportunity of being heard must be given to the school.
III. Upon withdrawal, students must be shifted to another recognized school.
IV. The school can continue operating for one academic year after withdrawal. Which of the above are correct as per the RTE Act?
questions.explanation_english: Withdrawing school recognition under Section 18 requires identifying statutory contraventions, serving a show-cause notice to grant an opportunity of being heard, and issuing an order. Upon withdrawal, the school must cease operations immediately, and local authorities must re-enroll affected students in recognized neighbourhood schools.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर I, II और III है। मान्यता की शर्तों का उल्लंघन होने पर संबंधित प्राधिकारी नियमानुसार मान्यता वापस ले सकता है, लेकिन विद्यालय को सुनवाई का अवसर देना आवश्यक है। मान्यता वापस होने पर बच्चों की शिक्षा बाधित न हो, इसलिए उन्हें किसी अन्य मान्यता-प्राप्त विद्यालय में स्थानांतरित करने की व्यवस्था की जानी चाहिए। विद्यालय को मान्यता वापस होने के बाद एक वर्ष तक बिना मान्यता संचालन जारी रखने का अधिकार नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I, II and III

Withdrawing school recognition under Section 18 requires identifying statutory contraventions, serving a show-cause notice to grant an opportunity of being heard, and issuing an order. Upon withdrawal, the school must cease operations immediately, and local authorities must re-enroll affected students in recognized neighbourhood schools.

questions.question_english: Under the original RTE Act, teachers who did not possess the minimum qualifications required at the commencement of the Act had to acquire them within a period of:
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 23(2) of the original legislation, teachers who did not possess prescribed minimum professional qualifications at the commencement of the Act were mandated to acquire those qualifications within a period of five years, ensuring that the existing teaching workforce attained mandatory professional standards within a defined transitional period.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर पाँच वर्ष है। मूल अधिनियम में उस समय कार्यरत और आवश्यक न्यूनतम योग्यता न रखने वाले शिक्षकों के लिए योग्यता प्राप्त करने की संक्रमणकालीन अवधि निर्धारित की गई थी। इस प्रश्न में मूल अधिनियम की व्यवस्था पूछी गई है, इसलिए बाद के संशोधनों या बाद में जारी विस्तारित समय-सीमाओं को मूल प्रावधान से नहीं मिलाना चाहिए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) 5 years

Under Section 23(2) of the original legislation, teachers who did not possess prescribed minimum professional qualifications at the commencement of the Act were mandated to acquire those qualifications within a period of five years, ensuring that the existing teaching workforce attained mandatory professional standards within a defined transitional period.

questions.question_english: For an upper-primary school with an enrolment of 105 students, what is the exact number of regular teachers required under the RTE Schedule norm applied in the question?
questions.explanation_english: For upper primary classes (Classes 6 to 8), Schedule norms prescribe a Pupil-Teacher Ratio of 35:1. For an enrollment of 105 students, dividing 105 by 35 requires exactly three regular full-time subject teachers to cover core academic requirements.
questions.explanation_hindi: स्रोत प्रश्न की उत्तर-कुंजी के अनुसार सही उत्तर 3 है। RTE अनुसूची उच्च प्राथमिक कक्षाओं के लिए नामांकन के आधार पर विषय-शिक्षकों तथा आवश्यक शैक्षणिक व्यवस्था के न्यूनतम मानदंड तय करती है। ऐसे प्रश्न में नामांकन संख्या, कक्षाओं के स्तर और प्रधान शिक्षक को शामिल किया गया है या नहीं—इन सभी बातों को देखकर गणना करनी चाहिए। यहाँ स्रोत द्वारा दिया गया उत्तर तीन नियमित शिक्षक है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) 3

For upper primary classes (Classes 6 to 8), Schedule norms prescribe a Pupil-Teacher Ratio of 35:1. For an enrollment of 105 students, dividing 105 by 35 requires exactly three regular full-time subject teachers to cover core academic requirements.

III. विद्यालय भवन, शिक्षण-कर्मचारी और अधिगम उपकरण सहित आधारभूत संरचना उपलब्ध कराना।
IV. प्रारंभिक शिक्षा के लिए पाठ्यचर्या और अध्ययन-पाठ्यक्रम निर्धारित करना।
धारा 8 के अंतर्गत इनमें से कौन-सी समुचित सरकार की वैधानिक जिम्मेदारियाँ हैं?

questions.question_english:
Consider the following responsibilities mentioned in the RTE Act:
I. Ensure good quality elementary education conforming to the standards and norms.
II. Ensure admission, attendance and completion of elementary education.
III. Provide infrastructure including school building, teaching staff and learning equipment.
IV. Prescribe the curriculum and courses of study for elementary education. Which of the above are statutory duties of the appropriate Government under Section 8 of the RTE Act?
questions.explanation_english: Section 8 assigns comprehensive statutory responsibilities to the appropriate government. These duties include ensuring free and compulsory education, guaranteeing admission, attendance, and completion, providing necessary school infrastructure, building facilities, qualified teaching personnel, and learning equipment, as well as notifying the competent academic authority to prescribe a balanced curriculum conforming strictly to constitutional values and holistic development principles.
questions.explanation_hindi: स्रोत में दिया गया उत्तर विकल्प D है। धारा 8 समुचित सरकार के कर्तव्यों में गुणवत्तापूर्ण प्रारंभिक शिक्षा, बच्चों का प्रवेश और उपस्थिति, शिक्षा पूरी कराना तथा आवश्यक सुविधाएँ उपलब्ध कराना शामिल करती है। पाठ्यचर्या और मूल्यांकन प्रक्रिया निर्धारित करने की भूमिका अधिनियम की धारा 29 में शैक्षिक प्राधिकारी से भी जुड़ती है। इसलिए प्रश्न की मुद्रित उत्तर-कुंजी का उपयोग करते हुए, पाठ्यचर्या संबंधी कर्तव्य के सटीक वैधानिक विभाजन को मूल धाराओं से अलग से जाँचना चाहिए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) I, II, III and IV

Section 8 assigns comprehensive statutory responsibilities to the appropriate government. These duties include ensuring free and compulsory education, guaranteeing admission, attendance, and completion, providing necessary school infrastructure, building facilities, qualified teaching personnel, and learning equipment, as well as notifying the competent academic authority to prescribe a balanced curriculum conforming strictly to constitutional values and holistic development principles.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following criteria regarding the appointment of teachers:
I. Possession of minimum qualifications laid down by the NCTE.
II. Passing the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET).
III. Belonging to the local district strictly. Which of the above are mandatory requirements under the RTE framework for appointing an elementary school teacher?
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 23 read with NCTE notifications, mandatory requirements for appointing an elementary teacher include possessing minimum academic and professional qualifications (such as D.El.Ed. or B.Ed.) and passing the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET). Local district residency is not a mandatory statutory recruitment criterion under central norms.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर I और II है। RTE व्यवस्था के अंतर्गत शिक्षक नियुक्ति के लिए NCTE द्वारा निर्धारित न्यूनतम शैक्षणिक/व्यावसायिक योग्यताएँ तथा संबंधित नियमों के अनुसार TET उत्तीर्ण करना महत्त्वपूर्ण आवश्यकताएँ हैं। स्थानीय जिले का निवासी होना अधिनियम के तहत सार्वभौमिक अनिवार्य योग्यता नहीं है। इसलिए कथन III सही नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I and II

Under Section 23 read with NCTE notifications, mandatory requirements for appointing an elementary teacher include possessing minimum academic and professional qualifications (such as D.El.Ed. or B.Ed.) and passing the Teacher Eligibility Test (TET). Local district residency is not a mandatory statutory recruitment criterion under central norms.

II. बच्चे के निःशुल्क और अनिवार्य शिक्षा के अधिकार से संबंधित शिकायतों की जाँच करना।

questions.question_english:
Consider the following powers given to the NCPCR and SCPCRs under the RTE Act:
I. Examine and review the safeguards for rights provided by or under the Act.
II. Inquire into complaints relating to child's right to free and compulsory education.
III. Take necessary steps as provided under sections 15 and 24 of the Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005. Which of the above statements are correct?
questions.explanation_english: Under Section 31, child rights commissions (NCPCR and SCPCRs) possess statutory powers to review legal safeguards provided under the Act, inquire into individual written complaints concerning violations of elementary education rights, and take necessary investigative steps using powers vested under the Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर I, II और III है। NCPCR और SCPCR को बच्चों के अधिकारों के संरक्षण से जुड़े वैधानिक कार्य दिए गए हैं। RTE अधिनियम के संदर्भ में वे सुरक्षा-प्रावधानों की समीक्षा कर सकते हैं, शिकायतों की जाँच कर सकते हैं और बाल अधिकार संरक्षण आयोग अधिनियम में निर्धारित संबंधित शक्तियों का प्रयोग कर सकते हैं। इसलिए तीनों कथन सही हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) I, II and III

Under Section 31, child rights commissions (NCPCR and SCPCRs) possess statutory powers to review legal safeguards provided under the Act, inquire into individual written complaints concerning violations of elementary education rights, and take necessary investigative steps using powers vested under the Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005.

Arrange the correct sequence of actions for a student failing the Class 5 regular examination under the amended RTE Act:
I. Declaration of regular exam result
II. Holding back the child (if State policy permits)
III. Opportunity for re-examination
IV. Additional instruction/remedial classes
questions.explanation_english: The statutory procedure following regular Class 5 examinations requires first declaring the annual exam results. If a student fails, the institution must provide additional remedial instruction, followed by conducting a re-examination within two months. Only if the student fails this re- examination can detention be enforced, provided the appropriate State Government has formally notified such a holding-back policy.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही क्रम I, IV, III, II है। पहले नियमित परीक्षा का परिणाम घोषित होता है। असफल बच्चे को अतिरिक्त या उपचारात्मक शिक्षण दिया जाता है, फिर पुनःपरीक्षा का अवसर मिलता है। यदि बच्चा पुनःपरीक्षा में भी असफल रहता है और राज्य नीति ऐसी अनुमति देती है, तभी उसे उसी कक्षा में रोकने का निर्णय लिया जा सकता है। इस क्रम में उपचारात्मक सहायता को रोकने के निर्णय से पहले रखना महत्त्वपूर्ण है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I, IV, III, II

The statutory procedure following regular Class 5 examinations requires first declaring the annual exam results. If a student fails, the institution must provide additional remedial instruction, followed by conducting a re-examination within two months. Only if the student fails this re- examination can detention be enforced, provided the appropriate State Government has formally notified such a holding-back policy.

questions.question_english: Under the RTE Act, 2009, the term "compulsory education" places an obligation strictly on which of the following entities to ensure admission, attendance, and completion of elementary education?
options_english: The parents, legal guardians, and custodians of the child
The appropriate Government and local authorities
The statutory School Management Committee of the school
The Head of the Educational Institution or Principal
questions.explanation_english: Under the statutory provisions of the legislation, the term compulsory education creates a legal mandate specifically for the appropriate government and local authorities. They are legally obligated to ensure free admission, regular attendance, and successful completion of elementary education for every child within the prescribed age group, rather than placing legal penalties or prosecution on parents or guardians.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर समुचित सरकार और स्थानीय प्राधिकारी है। अधिनियम में ‘अनिवार्य’ शिक्षा का अर्थ केवल माता-पिता पर जिम्मेदारी डालना नहीं है। सरकार और स्थानीय प्राधिकारियों को यह सुनिश्चित करना होता है कि बच्चे का प्रवेश हो, वह नियमित रूप से उपस्थित रहे और प्रारंभिक शिक्षा पूरी कर सके। माता-पिता की भी जिम्मेदारी है, लेकिन अधिनियम की परिभाषा में संस्थागत दायित्व सरकार और स्थानीय प्राधिकारियों पर रखा गया है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) The appropriate Government and local authorities

questions.question_english:
Consider the following duties for which a teacher may be deployed under Section 27 of the RTE Act:
I. Decennial population census
II. Pulse Polio immunization drives
III. Disaster relief duties
IV. Elections to local authority, state legislatures and Parliament Which of the above are legally permitted non- educational deployments?
questions.explanation_english: Section 27 strictly prohibits deploying teachers for non-educational activities, listing only three specific exceptions: decennial population census, disaster relief duties, and elections to local bodies, state legislatures, and Parliament. Routine routine health drives, such as Pulse Polio campaigns, are not statutorily listed exceptions under Section 27's non-educational deployment restriction.
questions.explanation_hindi: स्रोत की उत्तर-कुंजी के अनुसार सही उत्तर I, III और IV है। धारा 27 सामान्यतः शिक्षकों को गैर-शैक्षिक कार्यों में लगाने पर रोक लगाती है, लेकिन जनगणना, आपदा राहत और चुनाव संबंधी विशिष्ट कार्य अपवाद के रूप में अनुमत हैं। प्रश्न में पल्स पोलियो अभियान को भी विकल्प के रूप में रखा गया है, लेकिन स्रोत उत्तर-कुंजी उसे अनुमत अपवादों में शामिल नहीं करती। आधिकारिक परीक्षा के लिए लागू वैधानिक पाठ के सटीक शब्दों को प्राथमिकता दें।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) I, III and IV

Section 27 strictly prohibits deploying teachers for non-educational activities, listing only three specific exceptions: decennial population census, disaster relief duties, and elections to local bodies, state legislatures, and Parliament. Routine routine health drives, such as Pulse Polio campaigns, are not statutorily listed exceptions under Section 27's non-educational deployment restriction.

questions.question_english: A 10-year-old child from a migrant family has never been enrolled in any school. The parents approach a local government school for admission. As per the provisions of the RTE Act, 2009, what must the Principal do?
options_english: Deny admission as the child has missed foundational primary classes.
Admit the child in Class 1 to build foundational literacy and numeracy.
Admit the child in an age-appropriate class (Class 5) and provide special training.
Direct the parents to an open schooling center as regular school cannot accommodate overage children.
questions.explanation_english: Section 4 specifies that a child who has never been admitted to any school or could not complete elementary education must be admitted to a class appropriate to their age. To enable such a child to adjust and keep pace with peers, the institution must provide specialized training through designed learning materials for a prescribed period after admission.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर आयु-उपयुक्त कक्षा में प्रवेश देकर विशेष प्रशिक्षण उपलब्ध कराना है। RTE अधिनियम की धारा 4 के अनुसार, जो बच्चा कभी विद्यालय नहीं गया या प्रारंभिक शिक्षा पूरी नहीं कर पाया, उसे उसकी आयु के अनुरूप कक्षा में प्रवेश दिया जाना चाहिए। उसे अपेक्षित अधिगम स्तर तक पहुँचाने के लिए विशेष प्रशिक्षण की व्यवस्था भी की जाती है। प्रवेश से इनकार करना या उसे अनिवार्य रूप से मुक्त विद्यालय भेज देना अधिनियम की भावना के विपरीत होगा।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Admit the child in an age-appropriate class (Class 5) and provide special training.

Section 4 specifies that a child who has never been admitted to any school or could not complete elementary education must be admitted to a class appropriate to their age. To enable such a child to adjust and keep pace with peers, the institution must provide specialized training through designed learning materials for a prescribed period after admission.

questions.question_english: A Principal observes that teachers are conducting weekly written tests and compiling the marks at the end of the year without assessing co-scholastic areas. To align with Section 29 of the RTE Act, the Principal should direct the teachers to:
options_english: Implement CCE assessing scholastic and co- scholastic domains.
Increase the weekly frequency of formal written tests and unit exams to twice a week across all subjects.
Conduct a single comprehensive term-end summative examination to effectively reduce continuous student stress.
Assess and grade students exclusively based on their daily physical attendance records and classroom discipline.
questions.explanation_english: To align with Section 29, assessment must move beyond rote written testing to encompass continuous and comprehensive evaluation. The Principal should direct teachers to evaluate cognitive understanding alongside co-scholastic domains, physical development, and creative skills using diverse, non-threatening assessment tools continuously integrated into regular classroom teaching activities throughout the academic year.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर CCE लागू करना है। धारा 29 के अंतर्गत पाठ्यचर्या और मूल्यांकन प्रक्रिया बच्चे के सर्वांगीण विकास, उसकी समझ तथा ज्ञान के अनुप्रयोग को ध्यान में रखती है। केवल साप्ताहिक लिखित परीक्षा के अंक जोड़ना सह-शैक्षणिक प्रगति को नज़रअंदाज़ करता है और CCE की भावना से मेल नहीं खाता। मूल्यांकन का उद्देश्य सीखने में सुधार करना होना चाहिए, न कि केवल वर्षांत में अंक देना।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Implement CCE assessing scholastic and co- scholastic domains.

To align with Section 29, assessment must move beyond rote written testing to encompass continuous and comprehensive evaluation. The Principal should direct teachers to evaluate cognitive understanding alongside co-scholastic domains, physical development, and creative skills using diverse, non-threatening assessment tools continuously integrated into regular classroom teaching activities throughout the academic year.
